title: 救生艇
summary: 每艘船最多载两人且总重量不超过 limit，求运送所有人的最少船数。
insight: 最重者一定需要一艘船；若还能与当前最轻者同船就配对，否则最重者独乘，这个局部选择不会减少后续配对机会。
pitfalls: 每船最多两人，不是任意多人
无论能否配对，右指针每轮都要左移

solutions.title: 最轻最重双指针
solutions.idea: 让每个最重者尽可能携带最轻者。

code.java: class Solution { public int numRescueBoats(int[] people,int limit){Arrays.sort(people);int left=0,right=people.length-1,boats=0;while(left<=right){if(people[left]+people[right]<=limit)left++;right--;boats++;}return boats;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numRescueBoats(people:IntArray,limit:Int):Int{people.sort();var left=0;var right=people.lastIndex;var boats=0;while(left<=right){if(people[left]+people[right]<=limit)left++;right--;boats++};return boats} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int numRescueBoats(vector<int>& people,int limit){sort(people.begin(),people.end());int left=0,right=people.size()-1,boats=0;while(left<=right){if(people[left]+people[right]<=limit)++left;--right;++boats;}return boats;} };
